driver: STM32N6 RCC HAL driver (on the verified RCC LL driver)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 14 + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.14 RCC register interface + memory map p.176 (owner decision 2026-10-15)
target.safety_allocation: OUT_OF_SCOPE: QM development, no safety allocation or safety claims (owner decision 2026-10-15)

scope: HAL: hal_status_t API with HAL_RCC_ prefix, const config pointers, parameter checks, timeout-bounded waits, built only on the PROVIDED LL_RCC_ functions
HSI and HSE oscillator enable/disable with ready-flag wait in RCC_SR bounded by a caller-supplied timeout
Peripheral clock enable/disable and peripheral reset through the LL
The LL header is provided read-only (verified LL work order) and is not modified
Out of scope: PLL configuration, clock tree switching, security/privilege configuration, interrupts, low-power modes
